BiblicalUsage: Charabah is dry ground, and it is the ground God makes where there was only water. All in whose nostrils was the breath of life, of all that was in the dry land, died in the flood. Moses stretched out his hand and the LORD caused the sea to go back, and the waters were a wall while Israel went on dry ground. The priests stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan, and Elijah and Elisha went over on dry ground when the waters parted.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe dry ground is one of the Bible's great miracles precisely because it is so ordinary: God does not give His people wings, He gives them a path. The flood drowned the dry land, and the sea and the river opened to make it again. I hold that the God who makes dry ground in the middle of a sea can make a way through anything I face.
